description: Know when Google Workspace is having a problem, from inside a workflow. Ask whether a service is up right now and get a plain yes or no, list what is going wrong at this moment, post a one line summary of everything to chat, watch for anything Google has posted since your last check, search the published incident history by service, dates, severity or wording, read one incident with the whole update timeline Google wrote as it went, and get a counted report of how a service has been doing over the last quarter. It covers every service on Google's own status dashboard, from Gmail, Drive, Meet, Chat and Calendar to the Admin console, and works out each one's current status from the open incidents, because Google publishes incidents rather than statuses. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything. No account or API key required.
